documents.text: Employees receive 20 days of paid leave each year. Unused leave expires in December.
Reset your password through the IT portal. Multi-factor authentication is required.
Submit expense receipts within 30 days. Your manager must approve reimbursement.
Remote work is permitted on Tuesday and Thursday with manager approval.
Report security incidents immediately to the security team. Do not delete logs.
Application logs are retained for 90 days. Customer exports expire after seven days.
